current_date: 22 August 2024 (re-published with no changes from the previous list)
current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation checklist and planning application forms' hub page says the local list 'was re-published on 22 August 2024 with no changes from the previous list'. The list is a set of per-application-type web pages, and the workbook link (the Full planning application page) is one of them.

issues.detail: 'List date' and 'Date basis' are blank. The hub page gives the date: the local list was re-published on 22 August 2024 with no changes. The workbook should link the hub page (article/2443), since the list is spread over about 21 application-type pages and the Full planning page is only one of them.
issues.evidence: Hub page: 'was re-published on 22 August 2024 with no changes from the previous list'

issues.detail: Local requirements on the Full planning page missing from Grokbot's Full planning rows: Coastal erosion vulnerability assessment (in the Coastal Change Management Area and 30m inland of it); Electric charging plan (new dwellings and new floorspace); HMO details statement (new HMOs); Mineral resource safeguarding assessment (non-exempt development in mineral safeguarding areas); Rural workers dwelling needs assessment (all new rural workers' dwellings); Telecommunications site connectivity plan; Tier 1 groundwater risk screening (new or extended cemeteries); Topographical survey/cross-sections (slopes steeper than 1 in 14); Transport Assessment/Statement/Travel Plan (NCC Appendix A thresholds); Contaminated land assessment; Construction management plan; Flood risk assessment (7 triggers incl. 1ha+ in FZ1, all of FZ2/3); Noise impact assessment; Marketing evidence; Structural survey; LVIA; Landscape proposals; Planning statement (major, 1-9 dwellings, departures); Utilities assessment (10+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+). Many of these appear only under Reserved matters.

Advertisement-related text is placed under Householder: 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' and 'Planning Statement', both triggered by 'where an illuminated advert is proposed in the countryside', which is the lighting strategy trigger, not a householder requirement. About 20 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', although they come from the Full planning page itself, so the type is right but the note is misleading.
issues.evidence: Full page item 19: Lighting impact assessment '...or an illuminated advert in the countryside'

issues.detail: Triggers taken from the wrong item or cut short. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' carries the retail impact text ('Where the sequential test is met, the impact assessment shall... NPPF'), but the flood sequential test applies to all applications in SFRA/EA flood zones except changes of use and minor development. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' carries foul/non-mains drainage text, but the source requires a drainage strategy for all major developments. 'Ventilation / Extraction' reuses the Air quality text, but the source item covers commercial kitchen extract, air conditioning, heat pumps and refrigeration. BNG ('requirement for biodiversity net gain has been met.'), Archaeology and Heritage ('required within a heritage statement.') are fragments with no trigger.

Affordable housing trigger: the source applies 10+ dwellings or 0.5ha+, except sub-market area 3 where it is 15+ dwellings. The HRA rows omit the shadow HRA distance/size tiers (e.g. residential 10+ units at 400m-2.5km, 26+ at 2.5-5km, 100+ over 5km).

The source page itself is dated (last modified June 2022): its BNG entry says statutory BNG is 'expected in late 2023' and limits the trigger to the Filby, Rollesby and Winterton neighbourhood plan areas. Grokbot's Reserved matters BNG row repeats this neighbourhood-plan-only trigger, which understates the current mandatory BNG requirement.
issues.evidence: Full page item 4: 'all eligible development once the Environment Act applies (expected in late 2023)'

issues.detail: Tab items under 'Drawing / document standards' are paper-size and plan-presentation advice ('For major applications, any paper size will be accepted', 'preferably plans will be submitted on A3 paper'), not requirements. The 'Crime prevention / Secured by Design' row under Reserved matters is a list of guidance links ('Secured by design (opens new window) Bat Conservation Trust...'), not a requirement.

Air Quality and Ventilation rows share identical trigger text, as do the Archaeology and Design and Access Statement rows (combined text), across Householder, Listed building, Advertisement and Change of use.

summary: The link works and points to one page of the current web-based local list (re-published 22 Aug 2024), but no date was recorded and the hub page would be the better link. Full planning misses about 19 of the 41 local requirements on its own page, and several triggers were taken from neighbouring items.
